entities.name: Giovanni da Serravalle
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Giovanni da Serravalle, also known as Giovanni de Bertoldi, was a Sammarinese Franciscan and humanist, who became bishop of Fermo and bishop of Fano (1417–1445). He is now best known for his commentary on Dante.
